items.text: Explain what AWS Organizations is and when to use it
Distinguish between Management Account and Member Accounts
Explain what an OU is and how SCPs apply to it
Explain what an SCP is, including its effect on root users
Explain Consolidated Billing and its cost benefits
Explain what AWS WAF does and at which OSI layer it operates
List three types of WAF rules (IP-based, geo-based, rate-based)
Explain the difference between Shield Standard and Shield Advanced
Explain what DDoS is and how Shield protects against it
Explain what Amazon Inspector does and what it does NOT do (block vs report)
Explain the purpose of AWS Config and what 'NON_COMPLIANT' means
Explain GuardDuty's data sources and what it detects
Explain what AWS Security Hub does and how it complements other services
Explain the difference between IAM Access Analyzer and Amazon Macie
Explain the difference between GuardDuty (detect) and Detective (investigate)
Navigate to AWS Organizations and view account hierarchy in the console
Create an OU and move a member account into it
Create an SCP and attach it to an OU
Verify that an SCP is blocking access in a member account
Create a CloudFront distribution with S3 origin using OAC (private bucket)
Set the Default Root Object in a CloudFront distribution
Create a Route 53 Hosted Zone and add an Alias record pointing to CloudFront
Identify where to find WAF, Shield, Inspector, GuardDuty in the AWS console
Describe the WAF rule creation process (name, condition, action)
Answer: SCPs affect root users of member accounts (unlike IAM policies)
Answer: Shield Standard is free and automatic; Shield Advanced is ~$3,000/month
Answer: WAF operates at Layer 7 (application); Shield operates at Layer 3/4
Answer: Inspector finds vulnerabilities; Config tracks configuration changes; GuardDuty detects threats
Answer: Detective is for post-incident investigation; GuardDuty is for real-time detection
Answer: Macie protects sensitive data in S3; Access Analyzer detects external access to resources
Answer: Security Hub aggregates findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Config, Macie, etc.
Answer: Trusted Advisor red status = 'Action Recommended' (never 'Required')
Answer: ACM certificates for CloudFront MUST be created in us-east-1
Answer: WAF + Shield = best combo for full-stack attack protection
